review_basis: all 305 canonical and source-verified Otsu4 questions
semantic distinctness, emergency-context precision, answer uniqueness, and no-filler policy

decisions.rationale: The source explicitly requires grounding both the container and dispensing pump. The question preserves the emergency temporary-handling context and adds an equipment-pair decision beyond the existing generic grounding check. Only choice C satisfies the stated control.

The source specifies a concrete indoor boundary of two or more open walls while preferring outdoor decanting. This is distinct from generic leak-response ventilation and no other choice meets both the outdoor preference and the conditional indoor requirement.

collision_review.note: C001 is not a repeat of generic anti-static equipment checks because it requires the container-plus-pump pairing. C002 is not a generic ventilation variant because it tests the official two-open-wall emergency temporary-handling boundary.
